title: One Verdict Is Not Enough: Regression Testing Learned World Models and Their Test Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.41130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learned world models ship as software components whose model versions, preprocessing, and test harnesses change between releases. Work on model updates already counts per-sample regressions, or negative flips, that an accuracy check hides. Two problems remain: a test can pass under one configuration and fail under another, and a harness fault can produce erroneous scores and wrong verdicts without a crash. We present TetraState, a regression-testing protocol for paired possible/impossible video tests. Each test runs under four fixed model-native configurations; its number of correct verdicts assigns one of four outcome classes. Inconclusive tests and failed executions are reported separately alongside the verdict rate. Revisions are compared by per-test outcome transitions, and the harness is versioned as part of the system under test. translated_title: 一个判定结果是不够的：对学习型世界模型及其测试框架进行回归测试
translated_abstract: 学习型世界模型以软件组件的形式发布，其模型版本、预处理和测试框架会在不同版本发布之间发生变化。关于模型更新的已有研究已经统计了被准确率检查所掩盖的逐样本回归（即负向翻转）。但仍存在两个问题：一个测试可能在某一种配置下通过而在另一种配置下失败，并且测试框架的故障可能在不发生崩溃的情况下产生错误的分数和错误的判定。我们提出了 TetraState，一种针对成对的可能/不可能视频测试的回归测试协议。每个测试在四种固定的模型原生配置下运行；其正确判定的数量将其归入四种结果类别之一。无结论的测试和失败的执行与判定率分开报告。修订版本通过逐测试的结果转换进行比较，并且测试框架作为被测系统的一部分进行版本管理。在全部 506 个 IntPhys 2 Main 测试以及两个异构系统 Cosmos 3 Nano 和 V-JEPA 2 上，两个 V-JEPA 2
tldr: 该论文提出了TetraState，一种针对学习型世界模型的回归测试协议，通过在四种固定的模型原生配置下运行成对的可能/不可能视频测试、单独报告无结论测试与失败执行、并将测试框架作为被测系统的一部分进行版本管理，从而解决了单一配置下测试结论不可靠以及测试框架故障导致错误判定的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TetraState, a regression-testing protocol for learned world models that runs paired possible/impossible video tests under four fixed model-native configurations, separately reports inconclusive tests and failed executions, and versions the test harness as part of the system under test, addressing unreliable single-configuration verdicts and silent harness faults that produce wrong verdicts without crashing.
